We write to travelers

Travel with pets: what to check before you go

Please make sure your animal is ready for loading, because the safest trip starts with a calm and secure kennel. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways checks travel plans with care, and we always put comfort and safety ahead of speed.

If you are traveling with a bird, <<FACT F077>>. Please bring the right carrier, keep it clean, and make sure it is easy to close firmly. If your pet is a rabbit, <<FACT F082>>. A healthy, settled animal usually handles the airport routine better, so it helps to keep food, water, and familiar bedding close at hand.

Our team will look over your papers, confirm the kennel fits the journey, and point out anything that needs attention before you reach the gate. If anything seems uncertain, please ask early so we can help you avoid delays and stress for your pet.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure for the latest guidance and a calm handoff.
